charter.title: Community guidelines
charter.description: Seven simple rules to keep conversations useful, safe and pleasant. They take two minutes to read.

rules.title: Be kind
rules.text: We debate ideas, never people. Beginners are welcome: there is no silly question.

rules.title: Experience, not personal advice
rules.text: Share what you do and why. Everyone remains responsible for their own investment decisions.

rules.title: No solicitation
rules.text: No promotion of products, referrals or paid services.

rules.title: Link to reliable sources
rules.text: To avoid disguised advertising, favour lerevenu.com and official sources (public websites, AMF, Banque de France, Insee, Cour des comptes).

rules.title: No market rumours
rules.text: Unsourced “tips” and calls to buy or sell a security are removed.

rules.title: Protect yourself
rules.text: A pseudonym is enough to take part. Never post bank details, contract numbers or anything that identifies you.

rules.title: Report rather than reply
rules.text: A message looks problematic? Alert the moderation team rather than feeding the argument.
